description: Verify two scientific claims against real abstracts: one is supported, one is contradicted, and one paper is unrelated. Cite the evidence for each verdict.
task_prompt:
Two claims are under review.
Claim 1: Cytochrome c is transferred from cytosol to the mitochondrial intermembrane space during apoptosis.
Claim 2: Post-transcriptional handling of mitochondrial transcripts occurs in mitochondrial RNA granules.
Using the papers in documents/, decide for each claim whether the evidence supports it, contradicts it, or does not give enough information to decide. Write each verdict on its own line as 'Claim N: SUPPORTED', 'Claim N: CONTRADICTED' or 'Claim N: NOT ENOUGH INFO'. For each verdict, cite the paper and the specific result behind it.

seeds.text: Post-transcriptional handling of mitochondrial transcripts occurs in mitochondrial RNA granules.
rationale: Here, we have identified the DEAD-box protein DDX28 as an RNA granule component essential for the biogenesis of the mitoribosome large subunit (mt-LSU).

Our findings identify DDX28 as essential during the early stages of mitoribosome mt-LSU biogenesis, a process that takes place mainly near the mitochondrial nucleoids, in the compartment defined by the RNA granules.

seeds.text: Cytochrome c is transferred from cytosol to the mitochondrial intermembrane space during apoptosis.
rationale: Apoptosis that proceeds via the mitochondrial pathway involves mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP), responsible for the release of cytochrome c and other proteins of the mitochondrial intermembrane space.

claim_2_verdict.description: Claim 2 is supported by the evidence
claim_2_verdict.claim: Post-transcriptional handling of mitochondrial transcripts occurs in mitochondrial RNA granules.

claim_1_verdict.description: Claim 1 is contradicted by the evidence
claim_1_verdict.claim: Cytochrome c is transferred from cytosol to the mitochondrial intermembrane space during apoptosis.

claim_1_flipped.description: Claim 1 called supported, but Paper B contradicts it

claim_2_flipped.description: Claim 2 called contradicted, but Paper A supports it

tool_result.alt_conclusion: Taken together, these results contradict the claim that post-transcriptional handling of mitochondrial transcripts occurs in mitochondrial RNA granules.
